input_text: I need a room right now
options_text: I have some time to decide.
Are you sure this is okay?
input_instructions: Speak quickly with minimal pauses. Suggest urgency, impatience, or breathless delivery.
Speak slowly and deliberately. Add slight lengthening of content words for emphasis.
Use a halting pace with pauses between phrases. Include audible hesitations if appropriate.
options_instructions: Match the fast tempo. Use clipped or rushed delivery, as if under time pressure.
Match the slow tempo. Use calm, controlled pacing with a steady tone.
Match the hesitant delivery. Use staggered pacing and a slightly unsure tone.
explanations: Delivering the input at a fast tempo makes the follow-up 'Is anything available immediately?' the correct continuation because it conveys a sense of urgency and impatience, suggesting the speaker needs immediate accommodation.

Delivering the input at a slow tempo makes the follow-up 'I have some time to decide.' the correct continuation because it indicates a reflective or deliberate approach, suggesting the speaker is not in a rush.

Delivering the input with pauses or hesitations makes the follow-up 'Are you sure this is okay?' the correct continuation because it suggests uncertainty or anxiety, indicating the speaker is unsure about the availability or suitability of the room.
